question: How many people were lifted out of extreme poverty in India between 2011-12 and 2022-23, as per the World Bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**171 million**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to **World Bank** data and research papers analyzing the **Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2022-23**, India lifted approximately **171 million** people out of **extreme poverty** between **2011-12** and **2022-23**.
 
• The **extreme poverty headcount ratio** in India, measured at the international poverty line of **$2.15** per day (**2017 PPP**), declined significantly from **18.7%** in **2011-12** to **6.4%** in **2022-23**.
 
• This decline indicates a steady reduction in poverty despite the economic shocks caused by the **COVID-19 pandemic**, showcasing the resilience of the Indian economy and the effectiveness of **social safety nets**.
 
• The **World Bank** estimates suggest that **rural poverty** saw a sharper decline
